items.html: The thing is that of those 288 sparks of the kings that died and descended to the world of Beria, when the correction of the eighth king, Hadar, came, he began to sort the sparks and the vessels from them, too. Everything that it sorted of them was only the Nukva parts in all the Partzufim. In the beginning, the selected and the best of them was sorted and rose in Atzilut.
